guidelines.do1: Mark required fields and validate when the field loses focus.
guidelines.do2: Write error messages that explain how to fix the problem.
guidelines.do3: Use the correct type and inputMode to bring up the right keyboard on mobile.
guidelines.dont2: Don't disable the submit button without explaining why.
